meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 能帮你创建和调试各种动画关键帧（如 GSAP、CSS、Anime.js 等），确保动画播放时精准、可回溯、不卡顿。
howto.when: 当你需要制作或调试 HyperFrames 项目的复杂动画关键帧时，例如要求使用 GSAP 时间线、CSS 关键帧或运行诊断命令。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 GSAP 平移动画，从左侧移到右侧。
say.note: Claude 会生成暂停的时间线并注册。

say.text: 用 hyperframes keyframes 诊断当前动画。
say.note: 运行检查并输出关键帧报告。

say.text: 给这个 SVG 路径添加绘制动画。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can create and debug seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes for HyperFrames compositions, using GSAP, CSS, Anime.js, and other mechanisms, ensuring precise and stable playback.
howto.when_en: Activated when you need to produce or troubleshoot keyframe animations for HyperFrames, such as GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, or running `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics.

say_en.text: Create a GSAP tween moving this element from left to right.
say_en.note: Claude will build a paused timeline and register it.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes keyframes to diagnose the animation.
say_en.note: Executes checks and outputs a keyframe report.

say_en.text: Add a draw animation to this SVG path.
say_en.note: Claude will use DrawSVG or stroke-dasharray.
